data.name: Morning Trail Ride
data.description:
*If you are staying with us, please add your discount code!*

#About
Enjoy a beautiful walk ride in Joshua Tree. This is a peaceful way to start your day! 


(Weight limit: 240 lbs) Riders must be 8 years of age or older. Some riding experience is preferred from children 12 and under.

meeting_point.address: 6353 Cascade Rd Joshua Tree, CA US 92252

data.cancellation_notes:
We ask that you arrive 30 minutes before your scheduled ride time. If you are not here by the rides departure, you will not be refunded. 
If you would like to cancel your reservation, we can offer a gift certificate for the full payment. 
If the reservation is cancelled within 5 days of the booking date then there will be a $25 fee per rider if a gift certificate is not preferred.
Same day cancellations/ no shows will not be refunded or accommodated
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking! Please come prepared with water, close toed shoes, and leggings/ pants. Arrive 30 minutes before your ride unless asked otherwise. 

Please wear sun protection!

Bringing carrots is highly recommended! You can reward your horse after the ride (: 

Our address is: 
6353 Cascade Rd 
Joshua Tree, CA 92252
data.pricing:
$160 per rider
Give us a call if you are a local or if your group is 5 or more for group discounts!
